merestone.name: Merestone: SSSI & Habitat Map
merestone.tagline: Every statutory designation on one map, in the field, with no signal.
merestone.keywords: SSSI map, protected sites UK, ancient woodland, priority habitat inventory, SAC SPA Ramsar, ecology desk study, preliminary ecological appraisal, PEA, biodiversity net gain, planning constraints, AONB, offline GIS
merestone.intro: Merestone puts statutory environmental designations on one map, on your phone, in the field, with or without a signal. The United Kingdom, Ireland, Spain and Portugal, with every layer drawn straight from the agency that publishes it.

sections.p: Drop a pin, choose a radius, and every designation inside it comes back sorted by distance, with anything on site flagged. Distances and bearings are measured, not eyeballed off a screen.

Export a dated PDF or text extract with a site plan, every record with its distance, direction and source, and just as importantly the layers that were checked and found nothing in. Choose which sections to include before you export.

ul: SSSI and SSSI Units, SAC, SPA and Ramsar sites
National and Local Nature Reserves, National Parks and AONB
Ancient woodland, the Priority Habitat Inventory, wood pasture and traditional orchards
Open access land, listed buildings and scheduled monuments
Protected areas, geological heritage and walking routes in Ireland, Spain and Portugal
England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland, Ireland, Spain and Portugal, with the same map, searches and report throughout

sections.p: Download any layer, or the whole country, and it keeps working out of signal. Merestone uses live data when you have a connection and falls back to your download when you do not, and it says which it used, on screen and in the report.

sections.h: Built for the way the work happens
ul: Grid references in the system each country actually uses, and a search that accepts them
Presets for desk study, woodland, wetland, coastal and species work, or save your own
Favourites with notes, synced through your own iCloud with no account and no server
An Apple Watch app for what is around you right now
One purchase per country, covering iPhone, iPad, Mac and Watch

gainscout.name: GainScout: BNG Land Finder
gainscout.tagline: Check any field in England for Biodiversity Net Gain potential, in one tap.
gainscout.keywords: biodiversity net gain, BNG, land check England, habitat bank, off site units, land agent, planning consultant, farmland, SSSI, agricultural land classification, flood risk, green belt
gainscout.intro: GainScout is the fastest way to take a first look at whether a piece of land in England could be a candidate for Biodiversity Net Gain, the planning rule that has developers paying landowners to make land better for nature.

sections.p: Point the map at a field and press one button. GainScout reads that exact spot against official public government datasets and gives you a plain English answer in seconds, with every finding's source and the date it was checked. Nothing is estimated and nothing is invented.

ul: Statutory designations: SSSI, SAC, SPA, Ramsar, national and local nature reserves
Ancient woodland and priority habitats
Agricultural land grade, with the best and most versatile farmland flagged
Flood risk zones
Green Belt, National Landscapes and conservation areas
The Local Nature Recovery Strategy for the area
Registered biodiversity gain sites nearby, the off site market you would price against
Save sites and track them from watching to in talks
Add a walkover checklist, notes and timestamped evidence photos
Create a dated report with findings, sources, your photos and an OS grid reference, ready to hand to an agent, ecologist or buyer, and export it as a PDF
Area Scan to rank the most promising spots across an area
Draw your parcel to trace a boundary for instant acreage and a spot by spot check
Sites, reports and photos synced through your own iCloud

refast.name: Refast: 16:8 Fasting Timer
refast.tagline: How long is left. That is the whole idea.
refast.keywords: intermittent fasting timer, 16:8 fasting, fasting tracker, eating window, fasting streak, no subscription fasting app
refast.intro: A fasting timer that shows you the one thing you actually want to know, and does not try to be a food diary, a coach or a subscription while it is at it.

sections.p: Start your fast and Refast counts down your eating window on a single clear ring. Glance at it and you know. That is the app.
Every fast is recorded so you can see your streak and your trend over weeks rather than guessing. Trends are laid out to be read at a glance on the Mac as well as the phone.
No subscription, no account, no daily nudge to buy something. It keeps your data on your device.

recomp.name: Recomp: File Compressor
recomp.tagline: Pick a file, see its size, choose how small.
recomp.devices: iPhone · iPad · Mac · Apple Vision Pro
recomp.keywords: compress video iPhone, reduce file size, shrink video for Discord, WhatsApp file size limit, email attachment too large, PDF compressor, photo compressor, zip files iPhone
recomp.intro: Recomp makes files smaller, and that is the whole job. Pick any file and it shows you two numbers: how big it is now, and how big it will be. Choose a target, under 10 MB for Discord, 16 MB for WhatsApp, 25 MB for email, or any size you like, and press one button.

ul: Videos with hardware accelerated re encoding aimed at your exact target size, plus a force it smaller mode when every megabyte counts
Photos, JPEG and HEIC, compressed to a size you choose
PDFs, with text kept sharp where possible
GIFs converted to tiny MP4s that still autoplay everywhere
Audio as AAC at the size you need

sections.p: Any other file, documents, spreadsheets, project files, gets zipped. Pick several at once and they become one tidy archive.

Recomp tells you before it starts if a format has to change, such as PNG to JPEG, and tells you afterwards exactly how much you saved. If something could not hit your target it says so, with no invented numbers.
Everything happens on your device. No uploads, no account, no tracking and no subscription. Files you compress never leave your phone.

gridsong.name: Gridsong: Music Maker
gridsong.tagline: Tap a grid. Nothing you play can sound wrong.
gridsong.keywords: music maker app, beat maker, loop sequencer, make music no skill, pentatonic grid, lofi, ambient, drum machine, songwriting app
gridsong.intro: Gridsong turns a glowing grid into an instrument anyone can play. Tap a square and it plays a note. Tap a few more and you have a melody, because the whole grid is locked to a musical scale, so nothing you tap can sound wrong.

sections.h: No lessons, no theory, no wrong notes
sections.p: Drag across the grid to paint a run of notes, press play, and it loops. Start from a template or a blank grid.

sections.h: What you get to play with
ul: Ten built in instruments including Bell, Pluck, Glass, Voice and Bass
Drums, with tempo you control
Record your own sounds and play them across the grid
Loop, duplicate and layer patterns into a full song
Record a video of your loop and share it anywhere
Patterns synced across iPhone and Mac with iCloud
